rca of the issue: Reproduction: (1) Loaded env-provided base_url https://demobackend.emergentagent.com -> JSON 404 route not found at root. (2) Probed likely frontend host https://demo.emergentagent.com -> unrelated Emergent login page. (3) GPCountdown data-testids absent, causing selector timeouts. Root cause: environment/public endpoint mismatch, not necessarily feature implementation failure. Mitigation: correct deployment mapping and expose canonical frontend URL before functional E2E.
